title: Citation cache layer for the audit pipeline
description: Build a caching layer that stores fetched citation source pages keyed by URL and content hash. This will be used by future bead X once it is created to support incremental re-audits without re-fetching unchanged sources. The cache enables future bead Y (multi-repo audit mode) once that work is planned. For now the cache is built but not integrated into any existing pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Cache module stores and retrieves fetched pages by URL key. TTL of 7 days is enforced. Cache entries are invalidated when content hash changes.

metadata.intent: Provide a reusable caching layer for future citation audit pipeline work.
